baseline.method: Desktop Chrome, 1440x900 DPR1 balanced quality, no throttling. Common 20/100 and 25/300, or expanded 28/300 friendly/enemy fixtures. High HP, replenished enemies, zero enemy weapon damage, bile and resource/reward drops disabled to isolate battle cost. 15 s warmup followed by 12 s sample; backlog at both sample boundaries is recorded. No campaign, mobile or physical-phone performance claim.
